answer: Each answer burns u*(1+floor(w/10)) fee units, w being the lines its funding tree still has waiting: every 10 waiting lines add one terrace. With 82% of lines expiring at TTL 16, a tree of m wallets holds w of about 13m, so its bill is about 1.3m^2*u per epoch, while a lone honest wallet pays 2u past the first ridge at w=10. Trees are keyed by their anchor wallet; the cheapest bypass is m separately funded trees at 2u per line, linear, but each costs a real exchange withdrawal.
